A fork of Skitty's MoreComplications.

Adds more rows of complications to the lock screen.

* set the number of rows.
* set the spacing between rows & between complications.

Rootless build, not yet tested.
* show the package icon from this repo.

* rebuild the credits, with source code links under each author and a Tip on Ko-fi row.
* show the version and build scheme in a settings header.

* move to the com.cysxl package id, replacing Skitty's MoreComplications.

Changes from Skitty's MoreComplications:
* support roothide.
* add Row Spacing and Element Spacing.
* add a row instead of overfilling one.
* fix three and four digit hex colors.
* ship the credit pictures instead of fetching them from GitHub.
